notes.title: Minor bug fixes and suggested tweaks..
notes.notes:
..Minor bug fixes and suggested tweaks... 

[olist]
  You never have to see the VR (Tutorial) LVL again after 1 play through (hurrah)..
  Getting hit by a Bike doesnt hurt as much as a Car (Obviously)..
  More 'time' to get to the Invite Customer. 
  Added a Jingle if you complete a daily objective..
   Overall more 'Faster' and 'Challenging' ..
[/olist]
